subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should maintainers land this focused fresh-session recook-first fallback now, or require the reattach-first recovery direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 before merge?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session duplicate transcript state, but it intentionally preserves the broader two-run side-effect boundary for accepted disconnects, which is a user-visible fallback policy choice.

options.title: Land focused fallback now
options.body: Add the small docs update, land this narrow same-session fix, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked product issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first
options.body: Require this PR to wait for the detached gateway run first so accepted disconnects normally return the authoritative gateway result instead of recooking locally.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers do not want to expand the existing timeout-style recook fallback to accepted disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land focused fallback now
recommendation.body: Add the small docs update, land this narrow same-session fix, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked product issue.
